question: The Hindi novel ‘Indrajal’ is written by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaishankar Prasad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jaishankar Prasad** is one of the most famous Hindi authors and poets, known for his contributions to Hindi literature.
 
• He is best known for his historical and mythological plays, poems, and novels.
 
• Some of his notable works include 'Kamayani', 'Skandagupta', and 'Chandragupta'.
 
• Prasad's work often reflects a blend of romanticism and realism, and he played a significant role in the Chhayavad (Neo-romanticism) movement in Hindi literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramdhari Singh Dinkar**

 
 
• He was an Indian Hindi poet, essayist, and academician, considered as one of the most important modern Hindi poets.
 
• Some of his famous works include 'Rashmirathi' and 'Parashuram ki Prateeksha'.
 
• Dinkar's poetry is infused with patriotism, and he is often referred to as the 'National Poet' of India.
 
 
 
• **Harivansh Rai Bachchan**
 
 
• He was a noted Indian poet of the Nayi Kavita literary movement of early 20th century Hindi literature.
 
• He is best known for his early work 'Madhushala'.
 
• Bachchan's poetry is marked by a lyrical quality and a focus on themes of love, humanism, and existentialism.
 
 
 
• **Namvar Singh**
 
 
• He was a renowned Indian literary critic, linguist, and writer in the Hindi language.
 
• He contributed significantly to Hindi literature through his critical essays and analysis of Hindi texts.
 
• Singh was known for his scholarly rigor and his role in shaping modern Hindi literary criticism.
